description.value: Esquimalt Recreation Centre is a municipal multi-sport facility operated by the Township of Esquimalt, featuring a swimming pool, gymnasium, and ice arena. It offers a wide range of drop-in and programmed activities including aquatics, fitness, pickleball, and youth camps. For touring cyclists passing through the Greater Victoria area, the centre could serve as a stop for a swim or workout.
